label: Mode
name: mode
hint: Blank = a genie_response (or genie_error) means genie, a payload or action_id means click, a slack_channel_id (or alert_json) means post.

label: Slack channel ID
name: slack_channel_id
hint: POST: the channel (C0123ABCD, a private channel G..., or a user ID for a direct message). The app must be in a private channel (/invite @app). Blank and no payload = nothing to do.

label: Alert facts (JSON)
name: alert_json
hint: POST: the notifier's `alert_json` output, as is. Blank = a short alert is posted from subject, recipe_name, error_details, priority and job_url.

label: Slack bot token
name: slack_bot_token
hint: xoxb- token of the Slack app: chat:write (and chat:write.public for channels it has not joined), users:read and users:read.email for clicks. The step posts and edits messages itself.

label: Workato API token
name: workato_api_token
hint: Reprocesses the job and reads / writes the error log table. Blank = nothing can be reprocessed or logged.

label: Slack look
name: slack_look
hint: POST. Blank = short: one attachment with a red sidebar, in sections with a divider between them: the title and the headline, the error in a code block, the failed-records table, where it broke (source, Workato and target, a cross on the system that failed), then what happened, impact and what to do next as plain sections with one row of buttons (Reprocess / Mark resolved, links), and the status line with Take it last. Full = every section. Old = the plain card. If Slack refuses a block that one feature is left out and the message sent again, down to the plain card, then to text. In slack_features: -status_last puts the status back between the flow and What happened, and -dividers -flow -headline -status_last gives the short look before the recent changes; +grid swaps the plain sections for a 2 x 2 grid of boxes, but Slack refuses the grid inside an attachment, so it needs -bar.

label: Slack features
name: slack_features
hint: POST, optional. Blank = headers, bar (the red sidebar), cards, panels, datatables, tables, rich, feedback, dividers (a line between the sections of the short look), flow (source > Workato > target with a cross on the failed system), headline (the one-sentence headline as a small grey line under the title), status_last (the status with Take it after What to do next and the buttons), records_after_error (the failed-records table right under the Error section instead of at the bottom), meta_context (the retry / time / environment line under the headline as small grey text instead of a section). Off by default: footer (a last line pointing to the email, with the error's reference), card_icons (the icons on What happened and Impact), flow_icons (the compass and the icons on the line under the systems in Where it broke; the tick and cross on the systems stay either way), clock_icon (the alarm clock before the time), professional (summary first, the status right under the title, no decorative emojis, the time in each reader's own time zone). Names listed = exactly those. 'all' = every one. '+charts' adds one, '-dividers' takes one away, 'none' = just sections. Off by default: grid (the 2 x 2 boxes: Slack refuses them inside the red-sidebar attachment, so it needs -bar), charts, tiles, adaptive, chips, markdown (used by the full look).

label: Slack buttons
name: slack_buttons
hint: POST, optional. Which buttons that do something to show: reprocess, acknowledge, resolve, assign, diagnose (Diagnosis). Blank or 'all' = every one; '-reprocess' takes one away; 'none' = only link buttons. A successful reprocess always adds its own 'Check status' button on the thread reply (error_notification_check), whatever this says: it is how that one thread follows up, not a card button.

label: Slack mention
name: slack_mention
hint: POST, optional. Tagged at the top for Critical and High alerts only, e.g. <!subteam^S0123ABCD>, <!here> or <@U0123ABCD>.

label: Mask emails in Slack
name: slack_mask_pii
hint: POST. Blank = yes: email addresses in the error, the records and the details are shown as •••@domain.

label: Slack thread ts
name: slack_thread_ts
hint: POST, optional. Post as a reply in this thread.

label: Max table rows
name: max_table_rows
hint: POST. Default 25 failed records in the table (Slack takes at most 100).

label: Subject (fallback)
name: subject
hint: POST. Only used when alert_json is blank.

label: Recipe name (fallback)
name: recipe_name
hint: POST. Only used when alert_json is blank.

label: Error message (fallback)
name: error_details
hint: POST. Only used when alert_json is blank.

label: Priority (fallback)
name: priority
hint: POST. Critical, High, Medium or Low. Only used when alert_json is blank.

label: Job URL (fallback)
name: job_url
hint: POST. Only used when alert_json is blank.

label: Master job ID (fallback)
name: calling_master_job_id
hint: POST. Only used when alert_json is blank.

label: Slack payload
name: payload
hint: CLICK: the block_actions payload Slack sent to the Interactivity URL (JSON, or still form-encoded as payload=...). Map the trigger's payload field here.

label: Action ID
name: action_id
hint: CLICK, optional: the clicked action's id, when the payload is not mapped. Wins over the payload.

label: Button value
name: value
hint: CLICK, optional: the clicked button's value (the whole action button). Wins over the payload.

label: User ID
name: user_id
hint: CLICK, optional: who clicked. Wins over the payload.

label: Channel (click)
name: channel
hint: CLICK, optional: the channel of the message. Wins over the payload.

label: Message ts (click)
name: message_ts
hint: CLICK, optional: the ts of the message. Wins over the payload.

label: Selected user
name: selected_user
hint: CLICK, optional: the person picked in Assign to. Wins over the payload.

label: Feedback value
name: feedback_value
hint: CLICK, optional: positive or negative. Wins over the payload.

label: Genie response
name: genie_response
hint: DIAGNOSE, second call: the troubleshooter genie's answer (text, or the genie action's response object). Setting it makes this step post the analysis in the thread. Pass it together with genie_context.

label: Genie context
name: genie_context
hint: DIAGNOSE, second call: the genie_context output of the Diagnose click (the thread, the 'Diagnosing...' reply the answer replaces, who asked). Pass it unchanged.

label: Genie error
name: genie_error
hint: DIAGNOSE, second call, optional: why the genie gave no answer (the genie step's error). That reply then says the diagnosis failed, instead of staying on 'Diagnosing...'.

label: Extra people who may reprocess (per channel, JSON)
name: allowed_user_ids
hint: CLICK, optional. Text holding a JSON object of EXTRA people per channel, on top of the built-in team (always allowed): {"C0123ABCD": "U111,U222", "C0456EFGH": ["U333"]}. The key * = every channel. Plain "U111,U222" = those people in every channel. Blank = the team only.

label: Reprocess cooldown (min)
name: cooldown_minutes
hint: CLICK. Default 10: a job reprocessed less than this long ago is not reprocessed again. 0 = off.

label: Max reprocesses per job
name: max_reprocess
hint: CLICK. Default 3: a job reprocessed this many times already is not run again from Slack.

label: Update the message
name: update_message
hint: CLICK. Blank = yes. Puts who did what on the alert's status line, and takes the used buttons away.

label: Reply in the thread
name: thread_reply
hint: CLICK. Blank = yes. A short line in the alert's thread saying who did what.

label: Diagnosis line on the status
name: diagnosis_on_status
hint: CLICK. Blank = no: a Diagnosis click writes 'Diagnosis requested by ...' in a small grey line at the bottom of the message, and the status with Take it is left as it was. Yes = the old way: the line goes on the status line, above Open.

label: Slack signing secret
name: slack_signing_secret
hint: CLICK, optional. With raw_body, slack_request_timestamp and slack_signature the step checks the request is really from Slack and does nothing if not. Blank = not checked.

label: Raw request body
name: raw_body
hint: CLICK. The request body exactly as received (payload=...), for the signature check.

label: X-Slack-Request-Timestamp
name: slack_request_timestamp
hint: CLICK. The header, for the signature check.

label: X-Slack-Signature
name: slack_signature
hint: CLICK. The header (v0=...), for the signature check.

label: Error log table ID
name: data_table_id
hint: Default c1444a9a-03a7-4c82-8618-7796b7384b37 (Error Notification - TBL). A button can carry its own.

label: Workato API base
name: workato_api_base
hint: Default https://www.workato.com/api

label: Time zone
name: timezone
hint: Default America/Los_Angeles. The timestamps written to the error log use it; Slack draws the ones in messages in each reader's own.

label: HTTP timeout (s)
name: http_timeout
hint: Default 12 per call

label: Time budget (s)
name: time_budget
hint: Default 25: all calls share it

label: Now (testing)
name: now
hint: ISO time to act as. Leave blank.
